**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Match the tab to this event before skipping pane creation**

When another repository already has its project map open, the existing suffix-only URL filter selects that unrelated tab, so `$selection` is nonempty here: the new branch does not open the current event's map and instead reloads the other repository's map. The closed threat-table test at `.orchestration/dotfiles-T128-project-map-pane-open-a01/task.md:17-18` covers an unrelated non-map URL and an empty browser list, but not two distinct `/.project-map/index.html` URLs, so it does not close this case; compare the selected URL with the normalized event path before deciding the pane is present.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/73f51ab2a5a183bc52d845de986af7a36b70675d/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)
